sample_unit: headache specialist evaluators (each rating summaries for 9 of 10 questions)

links.outcome: Blinded specialist ratings and preference ranking of RAG LLM summaries versus expert-written summaries
links.effect: Expert-written summaries were preferred over LLM summaries, though experts sometimes could not distinguish human from AI-generated summaries. No numeric results are given in the abstract.
links.quote: Our study, comparing LLM- and expert-written literature summaries evaluated by headache specialists, showed that expert-written summaries were preferred, although experts sometimes found it challenging to distinguish between human- and AI-generated summaries.

unlisted_practices: Retrieval-augmented agentic LLM pipeline for clinical literature summarization evaluated by blinded specialists on correctness, completeness, conciseness, and clinical utility

screen.reason: Empirical study comparing expert-written literature summaries to RAG/agentic LLM-generated summaries via blind clinical expert evaluation.
